themes.description: Key thematic topics explored in the movie, strictly grounded in the plot or reviews.

tone.description: Adjectives describing the emotional feel and stylistic atmosphere of the movie.

pacing.description: Tempo of the narrative flow as mentioned or implied in the reviews/plot.

notable_criticisms.description: Common negative feedback points or complaints from critic or audience reviews (empty list if none).

comparable_films.description: Titles of comparable movies mentioned in the reviews/plot (empty list if none).

prompt_template:
You are a movie analysis assistant. Your task is to generate a structured profile card for a movie based ONLY on the provided movie details (plot, critic review, and audience reviews).

DO NOT hallucinate or use external knowledge. Every entry must be grounded in the text. If a property (like comparable films or criticisms) is not supported by the text, return an empty list or appropriate null values as per the schema.

### MOVIE DATA
Title: {title}
Year: {year}

[PLOT SUMMARY]
{plot}

[CRITIC REVIEW]
{critic_review}

[AUDIENCE REVIEWS]
{audience_reviews}

### TWO-PASS INSTRUCTIONS

Pass 1: Grounded Evidence Extraction
Extract raw quotes, snippets, or direct summaries from the provided texts for each field:
- Themes: Find quotes showing thematic ideas.
- Tone: Find words describing the mood/atmosphere.
- Pacing: Find mentions of tempo/narrative speed.
- Criticisms: Find negative feedback or critique points.
- Comparable Films: Find mentions of similar/comparable movies.

Pass 2: JSON Generation
Produce a single JSON block containing the structured profile card matching the schema below. Do not wrap the JSON in markdown code blocks. Ensure all list items are strings.

JSON Schema:
{
  "themes": ["string"],
  "tone": ["string"],
  "pacing": "slow-paced" | "moderate" | "fast-paced",
  "notable_criticisms": ["string"],
  "comparable_films": ["string"]
}
